name: Remove Duplicate Lines
desc: Clean a list by removing repeated lines, with optional sorting
seoDescription: Remove duplicate lines from any list online. Trim spaces, ignore case, drop empty lines and sort A to Z. Free, instant and private.
intro: Paste a list of emails, keywords, URLs or names and instantly get a clean copy with every repeated line removed. Optionally trim spaces, ignore upper and lower case, remove blank lines, or sort the result.
steps: Paste your list, one item per line.

faq.q: Does it keep the first or last copy?
faq.a: It keeps the first time each line appears and removes later copies.
Yes. Turn on 'Ignore upper/lower case' so 'Apple' and 'apple' count as the same line.
